##### Project general facts

The Weave – Al Ghurair is a contemporary residential building designed by the award-winning Australian architect Joe Adsett. Its facade is inspired by the traditional weaving of palm fronds, with captivating angles and intertwining balconies that create a dialogue between heritage and modernity. The building rises above a ground floor and a five-level podium to thirteen residential floors and a rooftop, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments and a limited selection of three-bedroom homes with a maid's room or study.

The rooftop residents club is designed as an extension of home, connecting wellness, fitness and social life. Residents can unwind at the infinity pool and softly lit pool deck, or gather at the outdoor barbecue and dining area. A wellness corner brings together jacuzzis, an ice bath, a steam room and a sauna, while a rooftop fitness and yoga studio supports an active routine. A private cinema, a social lounge and a herb garden complete the offer.

Interiors are shaped around light-filled spaces, flowing layouts and warm finishes that create a calm, natural atmosphere. Kitchens feature a contemporary island with natural tones and state-of-the-art appliances, while spa-inspired bathrooms combine elegant stone finishes with neutral accents. Bedrooms offer soft colour palettes and spacious built-in wardrobes, and two-bedroom homes include private master suites and a study corner. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of new Dubai, known for its circular layout, tree-lined streets and numerous parks. It brings together villas, townhouses and apartment buildings in a family-friendly setting, with Circle Mall serving as the main hub for shopping, dining and entertainment. Supermarkets, schools, nurseries and healthcare facilities are spread across the community, alongside walking paths and landscaped open spaces.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Hessa Street connect the community with Dubai Hills Mall, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Khalifa and both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International airports. Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai International Cricket Stadium, Dubai Autodrome, Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club and Jebel Ali Racecourse are all within easy reach, offering a wide choice of sport and leisure close to home.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most actively traded residential areas. Strong demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields and steady occupancy. A central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of homes keep the area popular with both investors and end users seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city.
